exposure: umbilical cord heat shock protein 70 (HSP70) levels
outcome: umbilical cord heat shock protein 70 (HSP70) levels
cohort: The study participants included 62 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 22 non-diabetic, healthy women scheduled for cesarean section as the control group.
finding: Maternal serum HSP70 levels were significantly higher in women with GDM compared to healthy pregnant women, and umbilical cord HSP70 levels showed a negative correlation with the time of delivery in women with GDM, suggesting a potential indicator for preterm delivery risk.
